description: Cancel a UCP checkout session. Transitions to 'canceled' status. Cannot cancel already completed checkouts. Use ONLY for a checkout session created with ucp_create_checkout (Universal Commerce Protocol); for the standard flow (create_cart, preview_checkout, complete_checkout) do not call this tool. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED for this write unless sent as the `Idempotency-Key` header or `params._meta["trusteed/idempotency-key"]`. 1-128 chars from [A-Za-z0-9._:/-]. Reuse the same value when retrying the same operation.

name: ucp_cancel_checkout
